info.title: StuHelper Storage API
info.description: Internal service and storage administration API. Current issuer/subject authorization is mandatory on every operation. Target replicas 3, initial publication 2; encryption deferred. Account domains and credential references are administrative data.

200.description: Verified complete content; no provider URL

206.description: Verified partial content range; no provider URL

304.description: Verified content unchanged for matching ETag

get.description: Authorized moderation/review download requiring storage.objects.review. Serves a verified complete copy even before initial publication threshold, without altering publication or references, and records an audit entry.

200.description: Verified complete content for review; no provider URL

get.description: Global operator-only snapshot requiring storage.operations.read. Bounded object and failed-job pages have independent cursors. No provider requests, credentials, provider paths or account identifiers are returned. Missing replicas do not imply an eligible replacement account exists.

post.description: Requires storage.operations.manage on the instance. Changes only the ledger; never logs in, probes or changes provider quotas. Atomic audit and idempotent response, current permission on replay.
Requires storage.operations.retry on the job and current object protection. Bounded queue admission and generation fencing. Never changes content access policy or bypasses account authorization.

Operator write-off for an ambiguous unknown-begin replica (issued_write=true and empty remote locator) after manual verification of the isolated provider directory. Requires storage.operations.manage, exact object and instance revisions, Idempotency-Key, and a non-empty sanitized verification reason.

get.description: Dedicated contribution service read grant, expected owner domain and contributor ownership required. Ledger only, no credentials or supplier calls.

409.description: Conflict. storage_contribution_limit_exceeded means the contribution exceeds provider capacity after personal reserve and safety margin. storage_contribution_capacity_unavailable means quota could not be verified using a current provider reading.

put.description: Requires storage.contributions.manage. Monotonic permanent control revision prevents old workers reviving a paused/exiting contribution. First binding requires a verified paused empty contributor instance. Does not extend provider authorization.

get.description: Service-only owner-scoped ledger lookup of verified paused empty contributor instances; never probes suppliers or returns custody material.
Storage custody only. No contribution consent, admission expansion, or secret readback. Password input is write-only and excluded from logs. Original request IDs are retained for recovery.

get.description: Sanitized community contribution capacity summary requiring dedicated storage.contributions.summary permission. Aggregates declared vs verified available contributor bytes from the ledger without probing providers or exposing per-instance identifiers. Returns 503 if a byte total exceeds the signed 64-bit range.

get.summary: Read the contribution admission policy as an authorized storage operator

put.summary: Replace the current revision of the contribution admission policy
put.description: Requires dedicated storage admission management permission. Applies the update and records audit evidence atomically. A stale revision returns conflict. Idempotent retries return the original response.

provider_free.description: Provider free bytes adjusted by the placement ledger. Returned for platform-owned instances only.

contribution_levels.description: Resolved contribution policy levels. Absence on a contribution instance means public only. Account authorizations and protection requirements still apply.

contribution_approval.description: Sanitized operator approval receipt for an adopted contribution. Never a credential or user identifier.

client_key.description: Optional stable key scoped to the service principal. Its object identity survives the 24-hour request replay window; changed creation parameters conflict and deleted objects are not recreated.

deduplicate.description: Create an independent logical handle whose verified content is shared only within the same service principal, protection, size, digest and replica policy. Hash-only creation does not grant content access.

reuse_from.description: Optional existing object or shared handle to copy without client upload. Requires deduplicate and current storage.objects.reuse permission on the verified source. Different protection requirements use separate physical groups.

reason.description: Capacity reasons are capacity_unknown when a current observation has not been recorded, capacity_read_failed when the latest quota read failed, and capacity_expired when the last successful read expired.

InstanceCommand.description: Current instance revision required. limit_bytes is required only for quota. Resume applies only to paused, still-authorized instances; it does not renew authorization. Quota cannot fall below used plus reserved bytes.

RetryJob.description: Only blocked jobs with unchanged object, instance, credentials and intent can be retried. Reuses the original remote write identity; unknown writes remain subject to reconciliation.

observed_at.description: Time of the last successful provider quota read. Null when a successful read has not been recorded.

capacity_status.description: The provider quota reading is either current, unrecorded, failed on the latest refresh, or expired.

reason.description: Capacity reasons are capacity_unknown when a current observation has not been recorded, capacity_read_failed when the latest quota read failed, and capacity_expired when the last successful read expired.

account_hint.description: Available to the owner and authorized administrators. Masked identifier from the bound provider account. For BHpan, replace each middle character of a login name of five or more characters with an asterisk, preserving the first two and last two. For shorter names, show asterisks followed by the last character (including a leading asterisk for a one-character login). Omitted when the account fact is unavailable.

subject_kind.description: Contributor key or membership in a storage-admission role or group.

items.description: Storage protection class. Initial levels are public, quarantine, restricted (non-paid) and paid-restricted (requires completed encryption and recovery support).

instance_id.description: Optional instance restriction. The instance owner must match the selector.

owner_domain.description: Opaque contributor key derived from the verified platform principal. Never a provider account or display name.

ContributionAdmissionPolicy.description: Complete policy snapshot. Instance-specific selectors precede global selectors. Contributor selectors precede role and group selectors at the same instance specificity. Equally specific role or group selectors intersect. Empty levels deny; no match defaults to public. Per-account authorization, school and protection controls still apply.
